planned_variables: Giovanni MERRA-2 (M2IMNXASM / M2TMNXSLV) temperature — needs Earthdata
GPM IMERG / GLDAS precipitation via Giovanni or Hydrology Time Series — needs Earthdata
AppEEARS MODIS LST / NDVI — needs Earthdata

methods.trend: Mann-Kendall test (two-sided p-value from Kendall's tau) and Sen's slope (Theil-Sen) with 95% slope confidence interval.
methods.significance: A trend is labelled 'clear' when p < 0.05; otherwise 'not yet clear'. A non-significant trend can still be informative.
methods.projection: 20-year linear statistical extrapolation using the Theil-Sen line and an approximate 95% prediction band. This is not a climate-model forecast.
